svg.title: Experience. 2024 → now: Elcano, Senior & Solutions Engineer, previously AI Engineer. Designed and built Manifest end to end: brief to live deals on 9 SSPs; MCP servers that let agents work safely on every SSP; Agent approval UX in Fleet; model fallback chain in Lens; Created Flag, the company design system. 2019 → 2024: Rightpoint, Senior Front-end Developer. Secure React Native app for a government client, iOS and Android; E-commerce design system in Next.js, TypeScript, AEM and MUI; Immersive 3D world in React and Pano2VR, driven by Contentful; SharePoint UIs in React and Storybook; design systems in React and Vue; Styles engineer and CSS expert on the Unqork low-code platform. 2017 → 2019: LevelEleven, Front-end Developer, UI/UX. Sales-management front ends inside Salesforce: React, Redux, Apex; Shipped releases to the Salesforce AppExchange and ran customer demos; Improved QA, and hired and trained new teammates. 2017 → 2019: Bread Factory Studios, Front-end Developer. Client-facing from scoping to launch: requirements, personas, wireframes; React and Gatsby front ends on REST APIs, shipped on Netlify. 2014 → 2017: RedCurrent, Content Manager, where I started coding. Events app covering 5 US cities; Ran Java scrapers that filled its MongoDB events database; Built tooling to speed up content acquisition and audits; Analytics reports, social channels, and a team of interns. 2014 → 2015: Offline Publishing, Marketing & Design Coordinator. Designed a digital magazine that reached #4 in the iOS Newsstand. Education: Grand Circus bootcamp, 2017; B.S. Marketing, Oakland University, 2014.
